blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection (ZSMAD) aims to identify both appearance and geometric defects in novel categories without relying on target-specific training data, making it especially valuable in real-world scenarios constrained by data scarcity, privacy concerns, or high annotation costs. While recent approaches successfully adapt vision-language models like CLIP to achieve this open-vocabulary generalization, they still face significant challenges: (i) severe geometric information loss during 3D-to-2D point cloud rendering; (ii) spatially noisy 2D feature maps produced by raw CLIP patch embeddings, compounded by shallow late-stage modality fusion; and (iii) severe cross-modal semantic misalignment due to decoupled processing streams. To address these limitations, we propose AggCLIP, a novel framework that adapts frozen CLIP representations for ZSMAD by explicitly incorporating local geometric structure and visual spatial context. Specifically, to accurately localize fine-grained defects, we design a Geometry-Aware Spatial Aggregation (GSA) module that refines back-projected 3D point features via density-adaptive neighborhood weighting, alongside a Context-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CSA) module that smooths multi-scale 2D patch embeddings using a lightweight trainable adapter. Furthermore, to prevent semantic drift between modalities, we introduce a Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive (DSPC) loss, which aligns the abstract concepts of normality and abnormality across the point cloud and RGB streams. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed AggCLIP framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies benchmarks under both one-vs-rest and cross-dataset zero-shot settings, notably surpassing the strongest competitive methods by up to 2.9% in pixel-level AUPRO.
blocks.zh: Zero-Shot多式联运异常检测(ZSMAD)旨在识别新类别中的外观和几何缺陷,而不依赖于针对特定目标的训练数据,使其在现实世界中特别有价值,因为数据稀缺、隐私问题或注释成本高。 虽然最近的方法成功地调整了CLIP等视觉语言模型,以实现这种开放-vocability泛化,但它们仍然面临重大挑战:(一)3D至2D点云渲染过程中严重的几何信息损失;(二)原始CLIP补丁嵌入产生的空间噪声2D特征图,加上浅的后期模式聚变;以及(三)由于脱钩处理流导致严重的跨模式语义错配. 为了克服这些局限性,我们建议采用AggCLIP,这是一种新颖的框架,通过明确纳入当地几何结构和视觉空间背景来调整ZSMAD的冻结的CLIP表示. 具体地说,为了准确定位精细的纹理缺陷,我们设计了一个几何-智能空间聚合(GSA)模块,通过密度-适应性邻里加权来完善回投射的3D点特征,同时设计一个上下文-智能空间聚合(CSA)模块,利用轻量级可训练适配器来平滑多级2D补丁嵌入. 此外,为了防止模式之间的语义漂移,我们引入了双层快速对流(DSPC)损失(Dusy-Stream Pointcontitive (DSPC)),该损失将点云流和RGB流之间的常态和异常性抽象概念相协调. 广泛的实验表明,拟议的AggCLIP框架在一Vs-rest和跨数据集的零射设定下,在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies基准上实现了最先进的性能,特别是在像素级AUPRO中,超过最强的竞争方法高达2.9%.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Paradigm comparison for zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection. (a) Existing ZSMAD pipelines typically suffer from three fundamental limitations: Geometric Loss during 3D-to-2D rendering, Spatial Noise and Weak Integration due to raw CLIP embeddings and simplistic late-fusion, and Semantic Misalignment between prompts and multimodal features. (b) The proposed AggCLIP framework effectively addresses these gaps. It refines noisy back-projected point features via the Geometry-Aware Spatial Aggregation ( GSA ) module, suppresses 2D spatial noise using Context-Aware Spatial Aggregation ( CSA ) paired with a learnable Adapter , and directly enforces deep cross-modal semantic interaction via the Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive ( DSPC ) loss.
blocks.zh: 图1:零射多式异常探测的范式比较. (a) 现有的ZSMAD管道通常受到三个基本限制: 3D到2D渲染过程中的几何损失,由于原始的CLIP嵌入和简单化的晚聚而导致的空间噪声和弱集成,以及语义错配的提示和多式联运特征. 拟议的AggCLIP框架有效地弥补了这些差距。 它通过几何-智能空间聚合(GSA)模块改进了噪音的后预测点特征,利用上下文-智能空间聚合(CSA)与可学习的适配器对齐压制2D空间噪声,并通过双相突变(DSPC)损失直接执行深跨模式语义交互.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Industrial anomaly detection (IAD) is a critical process in modern manufacturing, playing a key role in ensuring stable operations and minimizing economic losses [ 3 , 33 , 13 ] . Previous methods have primarily focused on RGB images for detection [ 11 , 33 , 42 , 19 ] . While these methods are effective for discovering texturing and surface defects, they inherently fail to capture structural and shape anomalies that are indiscernible in 2D projections. Consequently, modern industrial inspection systems increasingly demand the integration of paired RGB images and 3D point clouds for Multimodal Anomaly Detection (MAD).
blocks.zh: 工业异常探测(IAD)是现代制造业中的一个关键过程,在确保稳定运行和尽量减少经济损失[3,33,13]方面发挥着关键作用. 以前的方法主要侧重于用于检测的RGB图像[11,33,42,19]. 虽然这些方法对于发现纹理和表面缺陷是有效的,但它们内在地无法捕捉到在2D预测中不可分的结构异常和形状异常. 因此,现代工业检查系统越来越多地要求将配对的RGB图像和三维点云结合起来,用于多式联运异常检测。

blocks.en: Traditional MAD methods [ 38 , 10 , 16 , 9 , 24 , 40 , 35 , 47 , 34 ] typically rely on unsupervised learning schemas, which require training on a massive amount of defect-free samples from the target category. However, in real-world scenarios, acquiring sufficient training data for novel or diverse target categories is often difficult due to issues like commercial confidentiality, data privacy concerns, and prohibitive annotation costs. To address these challenges, Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection (ZSMAD) has emerged as an essential task, aiming to identify and localize geometric and appearance defects on unseen product categories without relying on any target-specific training data.
blocks.zh: 传统的MAD方法[38,10,16,9,24,40,35,47,34]一般依靠无监督的学习计划,这需要训练来自目标类别的大量无缺陷样本. 然而,在现实世界的情景中,由于商业保密、数据隐私问题和令人望而却步的注释费用等问题,往往难以为新的或不同的目标类别获得足够的培训数据。 为了应付这些挑战,零热多模式异常检测(ZSMAD)已成为一项基本任务,目的是在不依赖任何针对特定目标的培训数据的情况下,在未见产品类别上识别和定位几何和外观缺陷。

blocks.en: CLIP [ 32 ] , pre-trained on hundreds of millions of image-text pairs, establishes a powerful joint vision-language representation space with strong generalizability. Prompted by this capability, recent studies [ 49 , 14 , 28 ] have applied CLIP to zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection. The predominant paradigm involves rendering 3D point clouds into multi-view 2D images, processing these images with CLIP to derive anomaly concepts, and subsequently back-projecting the outputs to 3D space. However, as illustrated in Figure 1 , existing ZSMAD methods still face three major limitations:
blocks.zh: CLIP [32],对数亿的图像文本配对进行预训,建立了强大的联合视觉语言代表空间,具有强烈的通俗性. 在这种能力的推动下,最近的研究[49、14、28]将CLIP应用于零射多式异常探测。 占主导地位的范式包括将3D点云渲染成多视图2D图像,用CLIP处理这些图像以得出异常概念,然后将输出反投射到3D空间. 然而,如图1所示,现有的ZSMAD方法仍然面临三大限制:

blocks.en: 1) Geometric Information Loss. Projecting point clouds into 2D views discards fine-grained 3D structure, forcing CLIP to represent structural anomalies through 2D visual proxies and limiting its sensitivity to subtle geometric defects.
blocks.zh: 1)几何信息损失. 将点云投射到2D视图中会丢弃精细的3D结构,迫使CLIP通过2D视觉代位来代表结构异常,并将其敏感性限制在微妙的几何缺陷上.

blocks.en: 2) Spatial Noise and Superficial Modality Integration. Existing methods often discard paired RGB images or fuse them only at the final stage. Moreover, raw CLIP patch embeddings lack local spatial inductive biases, producing fragmented and noisy maps for dense anomaly localization.
blocks.zh: 2)空间噪声和超官方模式整合. 现有方法往往在最后阶段丢弃配对的RGB图像或将其引信。 此外,原始的CLIP补丁嵌入缺乏局部空间诱导偏差,为密集的异常局部化绘制了零碎而吵闹的地图.

blocks.en: 3) Cross-Modal Semantic Misalignment. Processing multi-modal visual inputs without an explicit semantic regularization mechanism inevitably causes domain drift. This leads to a severe misalignment in the conceptual understanding of “normal” and “abnormal” boundaries between the text prompt space and the decoupled RGB and point cloud representation streams.
blocks.zh: 3) 跨摩代语义错位. 在没有明确语义规范化机制的情况下处理多模式视觉输入不可避免地造成域漂移. 这导致文本即时空间与脱钩的RGB和点云表示流之间对“正常”和“异常”边界的概念理解严重错位。

blocks.en: To overcome these limitations, we propose AggCLIP , a simple yet highly effective framework for zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection. Our key insight is that effective zero-shot inference requires explicitly incorporating local geometric structure and visual spatial context into frozen CLIP representations while strictly preserving cross-modal semantic consistency. Towards this end, we design two modality-specific spatial aggregation modules tailored for anomaly perception. For the 3D branch, we introduce the Geometry-Aware Spatial Aggregation (GSA) module, which refines noisy back-projected point features using density-adaptive neighborhoods defined on the original 3D coordinates. For the 2D branch, we design the Context-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CSA) module, paired with a lightweight adapter, to smooth hierarchical 2D patch embeddings and suppress spatial noise. Furthermore, to mitigate semantic drift, we propose a Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive (DSPC) loss, which dynamically regularizes the textual prompt learners to rigorously align the abstractions of normality and abnormality across both modalities.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议采用AggCLIP,这是一个简单而高效的零镜头多式联运异常探测框架。 我们的主要见解是,有效的零射线推论要求将局部几何结构和视觉空间背景明确纳入冻结的CLIP表述中,同时严格保持跨模式语义的一致性. 为此,我们设计了两个适合异常感知的、针对特定模式的空间聚合模块。 对于3D分支,我们引入了几何-智能空间聚合(GSA)模块,该模块利用最初3D坐标上定义的密度-适应性邻里来完善吵闹的后预测点特征. 对于2D分支,我们设计了与轻量级适配器配对的Case-Aware空间聚合(CSA)模块,以平滑的等级2D补丁嵌入并抑制空间噪音. 此外,为了减少语义上的漂移,我们提议采用双层快速对比(DSPC)损失法,使文字上的学习者动态地规范化,以便严格地调整两种方式的正常性和异常性的抽象。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose AggCLIP , a universally applicable zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection framework that effectively bridges frozen CLIP representations with unified 2D appearance and 3D geometric reasoning. • We design GSA and CSA to refine back-projected point features with local 3D neighborhood context and RGB patch features with multi-scale spatial context, producing spatially coherent anomaly predictions. • We introduce the Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive (DSPC) loss, which explicitly enforces semantic alignment between the decoupled text prompt spaces and the multimodal visual feature streams. • Extensive experiments on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies demonstrate that AggCLIP establishes new state-of-the-art object- and pixel-level performance under both one-vs-rest and challenging cross-dataset zero-shot settings.
blocks.zh: • 我们的主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出AggCLIP,这是一个普遍适用的零射多式异常探测框架,它有效地将CLIP的显示方式与统一的二维外观和三维几何推理连接起来。 我们设计GSA和CSA,以完善具有本地3D周边环境的后期预测点特征和具有多尺度空间环境的RGB补丁特征,产生空间连贯的异常预测. ^ 我们引入了双层快速对流(DSPC)损失,它明确执行脱钩文本快速空间和多模式视觉特征流之间的语义一致. • 关于MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies的广泛实验表明,AggCLIP在一Vs-resst和具有挑战性的跨数据集零射设置下建立了新的最先进的对象和像素级性能.

blocks.en: We propose AggCLIP , a universally applicable zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection framework that effectively bridges frozen CLIP representations with unified 2D appearance and 3D geometric reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出AggCLIP,这是一个普遍适用的零射多式异常探测框架,有效地将CLIP的表示方式与统一的二维外观和三维几何推理连接起来。

blocks.zh: 我们设计了GSA和CSA,以完善具有本地3D周边环境的后期预测点特征和具有多尺度空间环境的RGB补丁特征,产生空间连贯的异常预测.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Classical Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 古典异常检测

blocks.en: 2D Anomaly Detection. Image-based industrial anomaly detection has been studied extensively under unsupervised and one-class settings. Existing methods can be broadly categorized into three major paradigms based on their underlying mechanisms. Feature embedding-based methods [ 11 , 33 , 17 , 39 ] construct compact representations of normal patterns extracted from pre-trained networks, subsequently detecting anomalies by measuring structural deviations against memory banks or learned generative density models. Reconstruction-based methods [ 13 , 36 , 2 , 41 , 19 , 18 , 20 , 26 , 46 , 37 ] leverage autoencoders and knowledge-distillation architectures trained exclusively on normal data, identifying anomalous regions by exploiting high spatial reconstruction errors. Furthermore, synthesis-based methods [ 42 , 44 , 45 , 7 ] artificially generate pseudo-anomalous training samples through procedural texture pasting or diffusion-based synthesis, thereby enabling discriminative classifiers to learn explicit decision boundaries. Despite their widespread success, these approaches operate entirely on 2D RGB images and are inherently incapable of capturing geometric structural defects that remain invisible in planar textures.
blocks.zh: 2D异常检测. 基于图像的工业异常检测在无监督的和单级的设置下得到了广泛的研究. 现有方法可根据其基本机制广泛分为三大范式。 基于特性的嵌入方法[11,33,17,39]构建了从预先训练的网络中提取的正常模式的紧凑表示,随后通过对照记忆库或学习到的基因密度模型测量结构偏差来检测异常. 基于重建的方法[13, 36, 2, 41, 19, 18, 20, 26, 46, 37] 利用专门接受正常数据培训的自动编码器和知识分散结构,通过利用高空间重建错误确定异常区域. 此外,基于合成的方法[42、44、45、7]通过程序性纹理粘贴或基于扩散的合成,人为生成伪异质训练样品,从而使歧视分类者能够学习明确的决定界限。 尽管这些方法取得了广泛成功,但这些方法完全在2D RGB图像上运作,在本质上无法捕捉到在平面纹理中仍然看不见的几何结构缺陷.

blocks.en: Multimodal Anomaly Detection. To mitigate the limitations of single-modality perception, the release of comprehensive large-scale datasets such as MVTec 3D-AD [ 4 ] and Eyecandies [ 5 ] has driven rapid progress in multimodal anomaly detection. By jointly integrating 2D texture features and 3D spatial information, this paradigm enables a highly enriched and effective representation of complex physical anomaly patterns. Representative approaches have explored a diverse array of cross-modal fusion strategies. These include augmenting classical handcrafted 3D descriptors with learned 2D features [ 21 ] , conducting bidirectional cross-modal feature mapping [ 10 , 38 ] , applying reconstruction-style multimodal distillation [ 16 ] , and leveraging prototype and shape-aware 3D geometric reasoning [ 9 , 24 , 40 , 34 , 35 , 47 ] . While demonstrating strong in-domain detection capabilities, these conventional multimodal frameworks remain fundamentally dependent on a massive corpus of defect-free normal samples from the target category for unsupervised training. In real-world industrial environments, strict constraints involving data privacy boundaries and prohibitive collection costs often make it exceptionally difficult to acquire sufficient normal samples. This intrinsic bottleneck significantly restricts their scalability, directly motivating the urgent exploration of zero-shot paradigms.
blocks.zh: 多式联运异常检测。 为了减轻单模式感知的局限性,MVTec 3D-AD[4]和Eyecandies[5]等综合性大型数据集的发布推动了多式联运异常探测的快速进展. 通过联合整合2D纹理特征和3D空间信息,这个范式能够高度丰富和有效地体现复杂的物理异常模式. 代表性办法探索了多种跨模式融合战略。 其中包括增加具有2D知识特征的古典手动3D描述符[21],进行双向跨模式特征绘图[10,38],采用重建式多式联运提炼[16],以及利用原型和形状感知的3D几何推理[9,24,40,34,35,47]. 这些常规的多式联运框架虽然显示出强大的域内探测能力,但基本上仍然依赖来自目标类别的大量无缺陷的正常样本进行不受监督的培训。 在现实世界的工业环境中,涉及数据隐私界限的严格限制和令人望而却步的收集成本往往使获取足够的正常样本变得格外困难。 这一内在的瓶颈极大地限制了它们的伸缩性,直接激发了对零镜头范式的紧急探索.

blocks.en: 2.2 Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 零发热异常检测

blocks.en: Zero-Shot 2D Anomaly Detection. ZSAD on unseen categories has become feasible by leveraging the generalized image-text alignment capabilities of CLIP [ 32 , 8 , 12 , 23 , 51 , 27 ] . WinCLIP [ 22 ] first applied CLIP to ZSAD tasks by aggregating sliding window features with compositional text prompts. Subsequently, various prompt learning frameworks [ 48 , 6 , 31 , 30 ] replaced static templates with learnable, object-agnostic, or context-aware tokens to adaptively capture localized defect semantics. However, these methods operate exclusively on planar 2D inputs, inherently restricting their capability to detect stereoscopic structural anomalies.
blocks.zh: 零射2D异常检测. 通过利用CLIP的通用图像文本对齐能力[32、8、12、23、51、27],在隐形类别上的ZSAD是可行的。 WinCLIP [22]首先将CLIP应用到ZSAD任务中,将滑动的窗口特性与组成文本提示聚合起来. 随后,各种即时学习框架[48,6,31,30]用可学习的,对象不可知的,或上下文知的符号代替静态模板,以适应性地捕捉局部缺陷语义. 然而,这些方法完全依靠二维板输入,本身就限制了其探测立体结构异常的能力。

blocks.en: Zero-Shot Multimodal Anomaly Detection. Extending ZSAD to multimodal inputs aims to jointly localize both geometric and appearance defects without any target-specific training data. PointCLIP [ 43 , 52 ] established the standard paradigm of rendering 3D point clouds into multi-view images for CLIP processing and back-projecting the features to 3D space. Building on this, PointAD [ 49 ] first adapted this paradigm to zero-shot anomaly detection by evaluating 3D structures from both point and pixel perspectives. Subsequent models like GS-CLIP [ 14 ] and ZUMA [ 28 ] further improved this pipeline via geometry-aware prompt regularization and training-free multimodal scoring, respectively. A fundamental limitation shared by these frameworks is their superficial incorporation of the native RGB modality and the total absence of explicit cross-modal semantic alignment. Our AggCLIP addresses this by incorporating local geometric structure and spatial context via modality-specific spatial aggregation modules (GSA and CSA) and enforcing multimodal semantic consistency via the DSPC loss.
blocks.zh: Zero-Shot 多式联运异常检测. 将ZSAD扩展至多式联运投入,目的是将几何和外观缺陷联合定位,而没有任何针对特定目标的培训数据。 PointCLIP [43,52] 确立了将3D点云渲染成多视图图像的标准范式,用于CLIP处理和将特征反投射到3D空间. 在此基础上,PointAD[49]首先通过从点和像素两个角度评价3D结构,将这个范式修改为零镜头异常探测. 随后的模型,如GS-CLIP[14]和ZUMA[28],分别通过几何-认识迅速的规范化和无培训的多式联运评分,进一步改进了这一管道. 这些框架的一个共同基本限制是它们表面融入了当地RGB模式,完全没有明确的跨模式语义一致。 我们的AggCLIP通过特定模式的空间聚合模块(GSA和CSA)纳入当地几何结构和空间背景,并通过DSPC损失加强多式联运语义的一致性,来解决这一问题。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of AggCLIP. GSA refines back-projected point-cloud features, CSA and a lightweight adapter refine RGB patch features, and DSPC aligns modality-specific text prompt embeddings before multimodal anomaly scoring.
blocks.zh: 图2:AggCLIP概览。 GSA精炼了后期预测的点云特性,CSA和一个轻量级适配器精炼了RGB补丁特性,DSPC在多式联运异常评分前对模式特定文本的快速嵌入进行校正.

blocks.en: 3 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3 问题表述

blocks.en: Given a multimodal input 𝒳 = ( 𝒫 , ℐ ) \mathcal{X}=(\mathcal{P},\mathcal{I}) , we aim to learn a unified model f θ : 𝒳 → ( s , ℳ ^ ) f_{\theta}:\mathcal{X}\to(s,\hat{\mathcal{M}}) that jointly predicts a sample-level anomaly score s ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] s\in[0,1] and a pixel-level anomaly map ℳ ^ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] H × W \hat{\mathcal{M}}\in[0,1]^{H\times W} . Here, the input consists of a 3D point cloud 𝒫 ∈ ℝ M × 3 \mathcal{P}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times 3} and a geometrically registered RGB image ℐ ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 \mathcal{I}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} . Sample-level anomaly detection can be formally defined as a binary classification problem, where the model aims to classify samples 𝒳 \mathcal{X} as either normal ( y = 0 y=0 ) or abnormal ( y = 1 y=1 ). Anomaly segmentation extends this concept to the pixel level, utilizing a binary ground truth mask ℳ ∈ { 0 , 1 } H × W \mathcal{M}\in\{0,1\}^{H\times W} . We operate within the Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection (ZSAD) context. blocks.en: 4 AggCLIP
blocks.zh: 4个AggCLIP

blocks.en: 4.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 4.1 概览

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 2 , we propose AggCLIP, a unified multimodal framework specifically designed for zero-shot 2D RGB and 3D point cloud anomaly detection. The primary objective of AggCLIP is to adapt the open-vocabulary generalized representations of a frozen vision-language model (CLIP) to the fine-grained demands of multimodal anomaly segmentation.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,我们提议采用AggCLIP这一统一的多式联运框架,专门用于零射2D RGB和3D点云异常探测。 AggCLIP的首要目标是使冷冻的视觉语言模型(CLIP)的开放式通用表达方式适应多式联运异常分化的精细要求.

blocks.en: The AggCLIP framework operates in three sequential phases. First, we independently extract base appearance and geometric representations by passing the native RGB image and multi-view rendered point clouds through a shared, frozen CLIP vision encoder (Sec. 4.2 ). Second, to compensate for the inherent lack of local spatial inductive biases in raw CLIP features, we refine these embeddings via two modality-specific modules: the Geometry-Aware Spatial Aggregation (GSA) module for density-adaptive refinement of back-projected point features, and the Context-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CSA) module paired with a trainable adapter for 2D spatial noise suppression (Sec. 4.3 ). Finally, to prevent semantic drift between the isolated visual representations during adaptation, we introduce decoupled prompt learners regulated by a novel Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive (DSPC) loss. This explicitly enforces cross-modal consistency by aligning the modality-specific text prompt embeddings for normality and abnormality across the point cloud and RGB streams (Sec. 4.4 ). By orchestrating these components around a frozen backbone, AggCLIP produces fine-grained anomaly score maps via text-visual similarity computation, enabling accurate zero-shot anomaly localization.
blocks.zh: AggCLIP框架分三个相继阶段运作. 首先,我们通过一个共享的冷冻的CLIP视觉编码器(第4.2条),将原生的RGB图像和多视图制成的点云通过传递,独立提取基质外观和几何表示。 其次,为了弥补原始CLIP特征中固有的局部空间诱导偏差,我们通过两个模式特有的模块来完善这些嵌入:几何-智能空间聚合(GSA)模块,用于对反投影点特征的密度适应性改进,以及上下文-智能空间聚合(CSA)模块,配以二维空间噪声抑制的可训练适配器(第4.3节)。 最后,为了防止在适应过程中孤立的视觉表现之间的语义漂移,我们引入了由新颖的双层瞬间对抗(DSPC)损失控制的脱钩的即时学习者. 这通过将特定模式的文本快速嵌入以在点云流和RGB流之间实现正常性和异常性(Sec.4.4)来明确实现跨模式一致性. AggCLIP通过将这些组件围绕一个冷冻的骨干来编织,通过文字-视觉相似性计算制作精细的反常记分图,使得准确的零镜头反常局部化成为可能.

blocks.zh: 4.3 多式联运特征空间聚合

blocks.en: A fundamental challenge in adapting CLIP for zero-shot anomaly detection is that its features, inherently trained for image-level alignment, are noisy and lack fine-grained spatial or geometric awareness. To bridge this gap, we design two core components of our AggCLIP framework: Geometry-Aware Spatial Aggregation (GSA) for the 3D modality and Context-Aware Spatial Aggregation (CSA) for the 2D modality. These modules explicitly incorporate local geometric structure and spatial context into the frozen CLIP features.

Furthermore, raw point clouds exhibit highly non-uniform density, being dense at sharp edges and sparse on flat surfaces. Traditional fixed-scale aggregation struggles with this variance. blocks.en: 4.4 Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive Learning
blocks.zh: 4.4 双层快速矛盾学习

blocks.en: In multimodal zero-shot anomaly detection, a critical challenge is maintaining consistent semantic boundaries for “normal” and “abnormal” across physically distinct modality representations, given that 3D geometric anomalies and 2D appearance anomalies manifest with vastly different visual patterns. Existing prompt-based methods typically adopt one of two strategies: either employing a single shared prompt template for all modalities, which cannot adequately capture the distinct characteristics of geometric versus appearance defects; or optimizing separate prompt learners for each modality in complete isolation without any cross-modal regularization. In the latter case, the independently learned semantic representations inevitably drift apart. Specifically, the 3D branch may associate “anomaly” predominantly with geometric deformations, while the 2D branch anchors it to textural irregularities. Both strategies ultimately lead to conflicting anomaly predictions during multimodal fusion, degrading detection and localization performance.
blocks.zh: 在多式零射异常探测中,一个关键挑战是保持“正常”和“异常”在物理上不同的模式表示的一致语义界限,因为三维几何异常和二维外观异常的视觉模式明显不同。 现有的即时方法通常采用两种战略之一:要么对所有模式使用单一的共享即时模板,无法充分反映几何与外观缺陷的不同特点;要么在完全孤立的情况下,在没有任何跨模式正规化的情况下,优化每种模式的单独即时学习者。 在后一种情况下,独立学习的语义表述不可避免地会分化. 具体而言,3D分支可能将“异常”主要与几何变形联系在一起,而2D分支则将其锁定在纹理异常上。 这两种战略最终导致在多式联运聚变过程中出现相互矛盾的异常预测,降低检测和本地化性能.

blocks.en: To address this, we introduce a Dual-Stream Prompt Contrastive (DSPC) learning strategy that decouples modality-specific prompts while encouraging cross-modal semantic consistency. We initialize independent sets of learnable context vectors for each modality. Let m ∈ { p , r } m\in\{p,r\} denote the modality (where p p represents Point Cloud and r r represents RGB image), and s ∈ { n , a } s\in\{n,a\} denote the semantic state (normal and abnormal, respectively). The prompt template for a specific modality and state is formulated as: T m s = [ W m , 1 s ] ​ [ W m , 2 s ] ​ … ​ [ W m , L s ] ⊕ state s ⊕ 𝐜 m T_{m}^{s}=[W_{m,1}^{s}][W_{m,2}^{s}]\dots[W_{m,L}^{s}]\oplus\text{state}^{s}\oplus\mathbf{c}_{m} (6) where W m , k s W_{m,k}^{s} are the learnable context tokens, L L is the context length, state s ∈ { “normal” , “abnormal” } \text{state}^{s}\in\{\text{``normal''},\text{``abnormal''}\} denotes the semantic state keyword, and 𝐜 m ∈ { “point cloud” , “RGB image” } \mathbf{c}_{m}\in\{\text{``point cloud''},\text{``RGB image''}\} is the modality identifier. By appending both the state label and the modality tag, the final prompt reads naturally as, e.g., “ [context] normal point cloud ”, grounding the text embedding to its corresponding visual branch. This dual-stream design allows each branch to learn modality-specific context representations while sharing a common state vocabulary.

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate our approach on two widely used industrial anomaly detection benchmarks: the real-world MVTec 3D-AD [ 4 ] and the synthetic Eyecandies [ 5 ] . Both datasets provide paired RGB images and point clouds, along with image-level labels and pixel-level masks for comprehensive evaluation.

blocks.en:
Evaluation Protocols. Following established zero-shot formulations (Sec. 3 ), we evaluate the generalization capability of AggCLIP under two distinct settings.
First, following the protocol established in [ 49 ] , we adopt the one-vs-rest setting to assess within-domain generalization: AggCLIP is trained on a single category and evaluated on the remaining unseen categories. Second, we explore a more challenging cross-dataset setting to measure generalization against domain shifts. To evaluate model generalizability on unseen datasets, we train AggCLIP on MVTec 3D-AD and test it on Eyecandies.
blocks.zh:
评估协议。 遵循既定的零射配方(第3节),我们评价AggCLIP在两种不同情况下的通用能力.
首先,在[49]建立的协议之后,我们采用 " 一vs-resst " 设置,以评估域内概况: AggCLIP接受单一类别的培训,并对其余未见类别进行评估。 第二,我们探索更具挑战性的跨数据集设置,以衡量域位变化的通用性。 为了评价模型在看不见的数据集上的通用性,我们在MVTec 3D-AD上训练AggCLIP,并在Eyecandies上测试.

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. We evaluate our method using four standard metrics. For object-level detection, we employ O-AUROC and O-AP, with the latter better reflecting performance on inherently imbalanced industrial datasets. For pixel-level localization, we utilize P-AUROC and P-AUPRO. We emphasize AUPRO as it weights distinct anomaly components equally, preventing large defects from dominating the evaluation. All metrics are reported as percentages.

blocks.en: Quantitative Analysis. Tables 1 and 2 demonstrate that AggCLIP achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance under both the one-vs-rest and cross-dataset settings. In the one-vs-rest evaluation, AggCLIP consistently ranks first across all reported metrics for both the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies. Specifically, on MVTec 3D-AD, it outpaces PointAD [ 49 ] by 1.4% in O-AUROC and 3.7% in P-AUPRO, while also achieving more precise pixel-level localization than strong baselines like GS-CLIP [ 14 ] and ZUMA-FT [ 28 ] . On the Eyecandies dataset, AggCLIP establishes new peaks of 79.8%/82.4% in O-AUROC/O-AP at the object level and 98.2%/89.8% in P-AUROC/P-AUPRO at the pixel level. Furthermore, under the more challenging cross-dataset setting, AggCLIP maintains its superiority against all competitors. It surpasses the runner-up by absolute margins of 1.2% and 2.0% in O-AUROC and O-AP over GS-CLIP [ 14 ] , alongside notable improvements of 1.0% in P-AUROC over ZUMA-FT [ 28 ] and 2.9% in P-AUPRO over GS-CLIP, successfully verifying its stronger generalization against domain shifts. More quantitative results are available in the Appendix.
blocks.zh: 定量分析. 表1和表2显示,AggCLIP在单vs-resst和跨数据集设置下都实现了最先进的零射性能. 在一流评价中,AggCLIP在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies报告的所有衡量标准中都一直排名第一。 具体地说,在MVTec 3D-AD上,它比PointAD[49]在O-AUROC中比1.4%,在P-AUPRO中比3.7%,同时也比GS-CLIP[14]和ZUMA-FT[28]等强基线更精确地实现像素级本地化. 在Eyecandies数据集上,AggCLIP在O-AUROC/O-AP中确定新的峰值为79.8%/82.4%,在P-AUROC/P-AUPRO中确定的新峰值为98.2%/89.8%。 此外,在更具挑战性的交叉数据集设置下,AggCLIP保持了对所有竞争对手的优越性. 它在O-AUROC和O-AP中比GS-CLIP[14]的绝对比值超过了1.2%和2.0%,在P-AUROC中比ZUMA-FT[28]和P-AUPRO中比GS-CLIP有1.0%的显著改善,成功地验证了其针对域位转移的更强通化。 附录中有更多的量化结果。

blocks.en: Qualitative Analysis. Figure 3 shows that AggCLIP produces anomaly maps with clearer boundaries and fewer false activations than GS-CLIP [ 14 ] . It localizes subtle or irregular defective regions more completely, while suppressing responses on normal textured areas. We attribute this improvement to our spatial aggregation modules (GSA and CSA), which incorporate local geometric structure and appearance spatial context into the frozen CLIP features, enabling more fine-grained and spatially coherent anomaly localization. This indicates that aggregating appearance and geometric information helps the model better distinguish true defects from category-specific visual variations. More qualitative results are available in the Appendix.

blocks.en: Because inference speed and resource management are critical for real-world industrial deployment, we evaluated the computational overhead of various methods, as detailed in Table 3 . AggCLIP consistently outperforms both ZUMA-FT [ 28 ] and GS-CLIP [ 14 ] across all efficiency metrics. Although it is marginally slower than PointAD [ 49 ] , AggCLIP yields substantial gains in anomaly detection and localization accuracy. This demonstrates that AggCLIP achieves an optimal trade-off between inference speed and detection performance.

blocks.en: Ablation on Different Components. Table 4 evaluates the contribution of each proposed component. The baseline (V1) retains only the dual-branch architecture with decoupled learnable prompts, omitting GSA, CSA, the Adapter, and ℒ dspc \mathcal{L}_{\text{dspc}} . Notably, integrating GSA into the 3D branch (V2) yields the most substantial single-module improvement (+6.2% O-AUROC, +4.1% P-AUPRO), confirming that density-adaptive geometric aggregation is critical for stabilizing noisy back-projected point features. A finer-grained comparison of different aggregation strategies within GSA is provided in the Appendix. Conversely, in the RGB branch, applying CSA (V3) and further equipping the Adapter (V4) progressively boost performance. The Adapter contributes an additional +1.3% O-AUROC and +0.9% P-AUPRO over CSA alone, validating the necessity of learnable feature adaptation for 2D appearance features. When the spatial aggregation modules from both modalities are jointly combined (V5), strong 2D–3D complementarity emerges, pushing P-AUROC to 98.0%. Finally, the full framework (V6), augmented with the ℒ dspc \mathcal{L}_{\text{dspc}} loss, achieves the highest performance across all metrics, verifying that explicit cross-modal prompt alignment effectively tightens semantic consistency.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented AggCLIP , a novel zero-shot multimodal anomaly detection framework that adapts a frozen CLIP backbone for dense industrial inspection. To bridge the gap between image-level pre-training and fine-grained defect localization, AggCLIP explicitly synergizes 2D appearance and 3D geometric information through modality-specific spatial aggregation and aligns them via DSPC learning. This design effectively overcomes the global bias inherent in pre-trained vision-language models. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that AggCLIP establishes new state-of-the-art performance on the MVTec 3D-AD and Eyecandies datasets across both one-vs-rest and cross-dataset settings, all while maintaining high inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了AggCLIP,这是一种新型的零射多式异常探测框架,它将一个冷冻的CLIP主干线用于密集的工业检查. 为了弥合图像级别预训和精细纹饰缺陷局部化之间的差距,AggCLIP通过模式特定空间聚合,明确协同2D外观和3D几何信息,并通过DSPC学习来校对. 这种设计有效地克服了预先训练的视觉语言模型中固有的全球偏见. 广泛的评价表明,AggCLIP在MVTec 3D-AD和Eyecandies数据集上建立了新的最先进的性能,这些数据集既跨越了一Vs-rest,也跨越了数据集,同时保持了较高的推论效率.
